sentences.l1: There are many tall buildings in the city.

sentences.l2: 高楼之间有一些小花园。
sentences.l1: Between the tall buildings there are some small gardens.

sentences.l2: 好看的房子很多人想买。
sentences.l1: Many people want to buy nice-looking houses.

sentences.l2: 想买的人多，房子就更贵。
sentences.l1: When many people want to buy, houses become more expensive.

sentences.l2: 贵的房子，老板可以赚更多的钱。
sentences.l1: With expensive houses, the owners can earn more money.

sentences.l2: 城市里种菜的地方很少。
sentences.l1: There are very few places to grow vegetables in the city.
Some people grow vegetables in tall buildings.
Vegetables can be eaten by people.

sentences.l2: 这样，城市里的人不怕没有菜吃。
sentences.l1: In this way, people in the city do not worry about having no vegetables to eat.

sentences.l2: 种菜和建花园都要花钱。
sentences.l1: Growing vegetables and building gardens both cost money.

sentences.l2: 花钱可以让城市更好，也是赚钱的方法。
sentences.l1: Spending money can make the city better, and is also a way to make money.

sentences.l2: 城市规划要让房子、花园和菜地在一起。
sentences.l1: City planning should put houses, gardens and vegetable plots together.
